question: Deploy auto calibration.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-calibration and walks the deploy reference: runs the platform preflight first, confirms the NGC key can access the AMC images before bringing the stack up, brings up vss-auto-calibration plus its UI, and verifies the microservice is ready at /v1/ready.
expected_behavior: Loads the vss-generate-video-calibration skill and its deploy reference.

Runs the AMC platform preflight before NGC/image/compose work, checks Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64, Driver 590+, non-root Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and NVENC compatibility, and stops to ask for existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight fails.
Verifies NGC access to the AMC images before docker compose up, brings up vss-auto-calibration and vss-auto-calibration-ui, and checks /v1/ready.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.

question: Set up AMC with VGGT on a fresh supported Ubuntu host where hf, uv, pipx, and pip are not installed.
ground_truth: Checks the Hugging Face CLI first, installs it through an isolated pipx environment when uv is unavailable, verifies the executable, and only then proceeds to hidden token entry and the gated VGGT download.
expected_behavior: Checks both command -v hf and hf --help before deciding whether installation is needed.

When uv is unavailable, installs pipx through APT if needed, installs huggingface_hub with pipx, resolves the pipx binary directory for the current shell, and verifies hf --help without first asking the user to install pip.
Does not use a user-site pip install, --break-system-packages, sudo pip, or request the Hugging Face token in chat; model access and hidden token entry come only after the CLI verification succeeds.

question: Calibrate these videos in ~/warehouse/videos.
ground_truth: Routes to the videos mode: runs the AMC platform preflight before upload/calibration, discovers sorted MP4 files plus calibration settings / alignment / layout files in the directory; requires confirmed staging or rectification, runs VGGT first when ready, post-processes it, then runs AMC and post-processes again.
expected_behavior: Routes to the videos mode of the calibration skill, runs the platform preflight before upload/calibration work, and stops instead of continuing automatically if the host is not supported.
Auto-detects the settings (including calibration_settings.json), alignment, and layout files when present.
Asks which detector to use (resnet vs transformer) when no settings file pins one, rather than silently defaulting.

Requires confirmed linear-media staging or completed UI/API rectification before calibration, validates any settings JSON against live AMC defaults/OpenAPI, starts or resumes VGGT first, post-processes both completed calibration methods, compares VGGT and AMC results, and confirms the resolved plan before starting calibration.

question: Calibrate these live RTSP camera streams.
ground_truth: Routes to the RTSP mode: runs the AMC platform preflight first, confirms VIOS is reachable, starts one all-camera capture via /v1/rtsp/capture, polls automatic ingest until INGESTED without a manual ingest endpoint, and only then runs VGGT/post-process followed by AMC/post-process and result comparison.
expected_behavior: Routes to the RTSP mode of the calibration skill.
Runs the platform preflight before VIOS probing/capture and stops instead of continuing automatically if the host is not supported.
Uses /v1/rtsp/capture, polls automatic ingest until INGESTED, stages or rectifies media, starts or resumes VGGT before AMC, post-processes each completed method, and compares both results.

question: Tune the AMC configuration for this custom video dataset; I do not know which detector or settings to use.
ground_truth: Routes through the tuning reference and uses the video reference only for source preparation. It compares both detector baselines, performs an evidence-driven follow-up when safe, and preserves VGGT and AMC results separately.
expected_behavior: Does not ask the user to choose a detector and budgets no more than five accepted AMC attempts.
Uses one stable readable dataset slug for new attempt projects and keeps ordinary calibration naming unchanged.

Applies the complete attempt configuration through /v1/config/<project_id>, verifies its readback, then follows the explicit stage, verify, VGGT, AMC, polling, post-processing, and artifact retrieval sequence.
For every eligible attempt project, safely sets up VGGT when missing, runs it, post-processes and preserves it, then runs AMC, post-processes and preserves it separately.
Selects from complete evidence, preserves the incumbent after a failed or degraded attempt, and labels a no-GT recommendation heuristic.

question: The normal AMC calibration finished. Continue tuning its configuration.
ground_truth: Reuses the valid normal project as attempt 1 without renaming it, preserves its existing results, and follows the tuning workflow for later attempts.
expected_behavior: Keeps the existing server project name and ID and maps them to a canonical attempt label only in tuning output and reporting.
Recovers the project's exact persisted configuration and detector, verifies configuration equivalence, and creates a fresh attempt 1 when either cannot be proven.
Preserves existing AMC and VGGT artifacts before another workload can reset shared post-processing results.
When reuse checks pass, counts the completed normal AMC run as attempt 1 instead of repeating it only to begin tuning.
